CRE-013.name: Eye Beast of the Sunken Archive

traits.name: Dead Pages
traits.text: A magic-dampening gaze: in a 150-foot Cone from its central eye, spells and magical effects are suppressed (not ended) while the beast's eye is open. It can close or open the eye at the start of its turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Eye Rays
actions.text: The beast shoots three of the following rays at random (roll 1d6 for each, rerolling duplicates), choosing targets it can see within 120 feet. 1. Forgetting Ray: DC 16 Int save or the target forgets the last hour, and has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. 2. Paralyzing Ray: DC 16 Con save or Paralyzed for 1 minute (save ends at end of each turn). 3. Fear Ray: DC 16 Wis save or Frightened for 1 minute (save ends). 4. Slowing Ray: DC 16 Dex save or its Speed is halved and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, not both, for 1 minute (save ends). 5. Enervation Ray: DC 16 Con save, 36 (8d8) Necrotic damage on a failure, half on a success. 6. Erasing Ray: DC 16 Dex save or 45 (10d8) Force damage; a creature reduced to 0 Hit Points is reduced to grey dust and fine ash, and a book it carried goes blank.

legendary.name: Uses
legendary.text: 3, regained at the start of the beast's turn. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can expend a use to take one of the following actions.

legendary.name: Glance
legendary.text: The beast uses Eye Rays, shooting one ray.

legendary.name: Reshelve
legendary.text: The beast flies up to half its Fly Speed, and one book within 30 feet flies to its side.

actions.text: The fragment uses Gaze twice.

actions.name: Gaze
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature it can see within 120 feet. Failure: 45 (10d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Unremember (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature of its choice in a 60-foot Emanation. Failure: 54 (12d8) Force damage, and the target is forgotten: until the end of its next turn, no creature can see or target it, and it can't affect any creature. Success: Half damage only.

legendary.name: Uses
legendary.text: 3, regained at the start of its turn. Immediately after another creature's turn, it can expend a use to take one of the following actions.

legendary.name: Notice
legendary.text: It uses Gaze.

legendary.name: Turn Aside
legendary.text: It moves up to its Fly Speed, and one creature it can see within 60 feet makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or has the Charmed condition until the end of its next turn.

CRE-301.name: Myconid

traits.name: Communion
traits.text: The elder can link minds with creatures within 30 feet through spores. Linked creatures can share thoughts and images, and understand each other, whatever their languages. A creature can refuse the link.

traits.name: Sun Sickness
traits.text: While in sunlight, the elder has Disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The elder makes two Fist attacks, or one Fist attack and uses Pacifying Spores.

actions.name: Fist
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (3d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Pacifying Spores (3/Day)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target has the Stunned condition for 1 minute (it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns).

actions.name: Animating Spores (1/Day)
actions.text: The elder targets one corpse of a Medium or Small creature within 5 feet. It rises 24 hours later as a spore servant (use Zombie) for 1 week, unless the elder releases it.

bonus.name: Hallucination Spores
bonus.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute and sees what the Bloom wants it to see. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

CRE-301.languages: None, but can communicate by Communion

traits.name: Still as Brush
traits.text: While motionless among plants, the blight is indistinguishable from dead brush.

traits.name: One of Many
traits.text: The Bloom sends blights in groups when it's angry. Use 1 per party member at levels 1 to 2, and add Vine-lash blights (same statistics, reach 15 ft.) at level 3 or higher.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The blight makes two Thorn attacks.

actions.name: Thorn
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

actions.name: Needle Volley
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

traits.name: Rot Gut
traits.text: A creature Engulfed by the mound is broken down: the Bloom builds something new from whatever it digests, and a creature that dies inside it is never found.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mound makes two Slam attacks. If both hit one Medium or smaller target, it uses Engulf on that target.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.text: The mound engulfs a Medium or smaller creature Grappled by it or hit by both Slams. The target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, can't breathe, and takes 13 (3d8) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the mound's turns until it escapes (DC 14 Strength check as an action) or the mound dies.

CRE-304.name: Treant

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: The Slowest Mood
traits.text: The treant is the Bloom being patient. It can't be Charmed or Frightened by anything the Bloom wouldn't fear.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Rock
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 60/180 ft. Hit: 28 (4d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wake the Trees (1/Day)
actions.text: The treant wakes up to two trees it can see within 60 feet. Each uses the treant's statistics, except it has 69 Hit Points, Intelligence 1 and Charisma 1, and can't use this action. It takes root again after 1 day.

CRE-304.languages: Common, Sylvan, and the Bloom's Communion

CRE-305.name: Walker

traits.name: Careful Steps
traits.text: The walker ignores Difficult Terrain, and never steps on anything it was told to protect.

traits.name: Heart-stone
traits.text: A walker has a heart-stone. If it's removed (a Walker's Heart-stone, ITM-311), the walker stops. Placed in another walker, it wakes as an ally.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The walker makes two Leg Strike attacks.

actions.name: Leg Strike
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Carry Off
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, one Medium or smaller creature within 10 feet. Failure: The walker lifts the target, which has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) and is carried as the walker moves.

reactions.name: Brace
reactions.text: Trigger: An ally within 5 feet is hit by an attack. Response: The walker interposes a leg; the ally takes half damage from that attack.

CRE-305.cimm: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
CRE-305.languages: Understands Kaelith work-commands but can't speak

CRE-306.name: Half-made

traits.name: Lockstep
traits.text: Half-made move together. While two or more are within 10 feet of each other, each has Advantage on attack rolls.

traits.name: Want to Be Finished
traits.text: A Half-made that is spoken to kindly, and told its name if anyone knows it, must make a DC 12 Wisdom save or stop fighting for 1 minute.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Half-made makes two Scrap Fist attacks.

actions.name: Scrap Fist
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Not Yet
reactions.text: Trigger: The Half-made drops to 0 Hit Points. Response: It makes a DC 10 Constitution save; on a success, it drops to 1 Hit Point instead, and keeps walking toward whoever might finish it.

CRE-306.languages: Understands Kaelith but speaks only in pieces

CRE-307.name: Hunter

traits.name: Built to Capture
traits.text: The hunter deals no damage when it reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points; the creature is Stable and Unconscious instead.

traits.name: Root and Wire
traits.text: In forest or the Bloom, the hunter has the Invisible condition while it doesn't move.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hunter makes two Wire Lash attacks.

actions.name: Wire Lash
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 15 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). The hunter can grapple two creatures at once.

actions.name: Bind
actions.text: Each creature Grappled by the hunter makes a DC 15 Strength save. Failure: It has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends, and is pulled up to 15 feet toward the hunter.

CRE-307.res: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing from nonmagical attacks
CRE-307.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Tremorsense 30 ft., Passive Perception 18

CRE-308.name: War-vessel

traits.name: Many Minds
traits.text: The vessel takes two turns each round, at Initiative counts 20 and 10 (losing ties), as its minds take turns. It has Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed, Frightened or Stunned.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: The vessel deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Minds Inside
traits.text: A creature that understands Kaelith can try to talk to the minds inside (DC 18 Charisma (Persuasion) as an action). On a success, the vessel loses its next turn as the minds argue.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vessel makes two Hull Slam attacks, or one Hull Slam and one Swallow.

actions.name: Hull Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 15 ft. Hit: 30 (4d10 + 8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition if it's Huge or smaller.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature within 10 feet. Failure: The target is swallowed. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, takes 21 (6d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the vessel's turns, and is among the minds inside, which beg it for a body. If the vessel takes 35 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it regurgitates everyone swallowed.

CRE-308.senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., Passive Perception 16
CRE-308.languages: Kaelith, in many voices at once

CRE-309.name: The Scattered

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The Scattered can move through creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Looking for a Body
traits.text: The Scattered prefers to possess rather than kill. A creature that agrees to carry it for a day can end its haunting for good.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Possession (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 12, one Humanoid within 5 feet. Failure: The Scattered enters the target, which has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The possession ends if the body drops to 0 Hit Points, the Scattered is turned or forced out, or it leaves as a Bonus Action. Success: The target is immune to this Scattered's Possession for 24 hours.

CRE-309.res: Acid, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing
CRE-309.cimm: Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
CRE-309.languages: Kaelith, and the languages it knew in life

CRE-310.name: Guardian

traits.name: Rebirth Core
traits.text: When the Guardian drops to 0 Hit Points, its rebirth core flares: unless the core is broken (AC 20, 30 Hit Points, reachable only while the Guardian is Bloodied) or doused in the keeping song, it rises at the start of its next turn with 60 Hit Points. It can rise once per day.

traits.name: Fire Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the Guardian takes Fire damage, it regains Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The Guardian has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Guardian makes two Slam attacks, or uses Core Flare and makes one Slam attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Core Flare (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 45 (10d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

CRE-310.cimm: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

CRE-311.name: Vessel

traits.name: Waiting for a Mind
traits.text: A vessel is empty until something enters it. A mind of the Scattered, or a creature that dies within 30 feet, can enter a dormant vessel; it wakes with that mind's Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma, and whatever that mind wants.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.text: Whenever the vessel is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The vessel makes two Iron Hand attacks.

actions.name: Iron Hand
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

CRE-311.cimm: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

CRE-312.name: Vault Ward

traits.name: The Asking
traits.text: A Vault Ward doesn't attack a creature that offers what its vault asks for (see the vault's page). It steps aside, and won't move again until the creature leaves.

traits.name: Bound to the Door
traits.text: The ward can't go more than 300 feet from its vault's door.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The ward makes two Ward-blade attacks.

actions.name: Ward-blade
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

actions.name: Seal (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation. Failure: The target is pushed 20 feet away from the vault door and has the Prone condition. Success: The target is pushed 10 feet.

reactions.name: Shield Another
reactions.text: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet of the ward is hit by an attack. Response: The ward takes the damage instead.

CRE-312.cimm: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Wrong Here
traits.text: The ground within 10 feet of the Thing is Difficult Terrain. A creature that starts its turn there makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or forgets which way it was going until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Thinning Touch
traits.text: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by the Thing makes the Thinning save at the end of the fight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Thing makes two Many-Mouth attacks.

actions.name: Many-Mouth
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Babble (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation that can hear it. Failure: The target can take only one action, Bonus Action or movement on its next turn, chosen by rolling a d3. Success: No effect.

CRE-350.name: Thinking Rot
CRE-350.trigger: A creature walks onto soft, pear-sweet ground where the Bloom's mind runs close (DC 13 Wisdom (Survival) to notice it first).
CRE-350.effect: The rot is Difficult Terrain. If the Bloom is hostile, at the start of each turn one creature on it makes a DC 13 Strength save or has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) as roots close over its feet. A creature grappled for 3 turns in a row is pulled under and has the Restrained condition until freed.
CRE-350.counter: Speaking with the Bloom (a Bloom-Speaker, or Communion) calms it for an hour. Fire burns a 5-foot square clear for 1 minute, and makes the Bloom remember who did it.

CRE-351.name: Spore-storm
CRE-351.trigger: A fruiting of the Bloom: a cloud of spores rolls in, about once a month in the Bloom country (local signs give a day's warning).
CRE-351.effect: Each creature in the open makes a DC 14 Constitution save at the end of each hour. Failure: Poisoned for the hour. On a second failure in the same storm, the GM chooses a lasting change: a new colour of eyes, bark on the hands, a voice that carries, an ear for the circuit-roots. These are the spore-storms that rewrote the Bloom-shaped peoples.
CRE-351.counter: Shelter indoors, a spore-mask (Advantage on the save), or Lesser Restoration ends the Poisoned condition but not a change. A Bloom-Speaker can ask the storm to pass by a village, once.

CRE-352.name: Bloom-shift
CRE-352.trigger: Crossing a visible line where the Bloom changes character, into a dead zone.
CRE-352.effect: In a dead zone, the Bloom treats anyone it doesn't know as a stranger. At the start of each hour, each stranger makes a DC 14 Charisma save. Failure: Roots and vines grapple them (escape DC 14), and the Bloom tries to learn them by reading their memories: 7 (2d6) Psychic damage each round while grappled.
CRE-352.counter: Travelling with someone the Bloom knows, or carrying Bloom-bread (ITM-312), makes you a guest, not a stranger. The Spore Circle can mark you.

CRE-353.name: Circuit-root
CRE-353.trigger: A creature presses an ear, or a hand, to the glassy glowing roots.
CRE-353.effect: A DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) check lets the listener overhear one conversation or memory carried along the roots within a mile. On a 20 or higher, they also learn where it came from. On a 9 or lower, the roots notice the listener, and the Bloom remembers them.
CRE-353.counter: Bloom-Speakers can ask the roots for something specific (Advantage). Cutting a circuit-root silences it for a day and angers the nearest Spore Circle.

CRE-354.name: The Glass
CRE-354.trigger: Someone tries to open a glass door of the old vaults or the under-roads.
CRE-354.effect: The glass swallows a fist and answers an open hand. Forcing it: the door holds, and the forcer takes 10 (3d6) Force damage. Opening it with an open hand and the right asking: the door opens, and each creature that passes through makes the Thinning save (see Thinning and Unmaking).
CRE-354.counter: Each vault's door asks for something different (see its page). Someone who knows your true name, holding it for you as you pass, gives Advantage on the Thinning save.

CRE-501.name: Greyling

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: It can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Turns at Any Name
traits.text: When a creature within 30 feet speaks any name aloud, the greyling turns toward it and must move toward it on its next turn.

actions.name: Whisper of a Forgotten Name
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. Failure: It forgets one name it knows (its choice) until it finishes a Long Rest.

bonus.name: Fade
bonus.text: While in dim light or darkness, the greyling takes the Hide action.

CRE-501.skills: Stealth +4 (+6 in dim light or darkness)
CRE-501.res: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder; Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing
CRE-501.cimm: Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained

CRE-502.name: Name-Eater

traits.name: Faces of the Eaten
traits.text: The Name-Eater can extrude a sulfur-grey copy of anyone whose memory it has eaten; a creature that knew them must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check to tell it isn't them.

traits.name: Small Ones
traits.text: For a Name-Eater spawn, use these statistics with 18 (4d8) Hit Points, Small size, CR 1/4 (50 XP), and only the Pseudopod attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Name-Eater makes one Pseudopod attack and uses Eat Memory.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Eat Memory
actions.text: Intelligence Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature within 5 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the Name-Eater learns the target's name and one memory; the target loses both until the Name-Eater dies. Success: Half damage only.

CRE-502.languages: Common, and the languages of anyone it has eaten

CRE-503.name: Lamp-moth Swarm
CRE-503.meta: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, Unaligned

traits.name: Light-Eater
traits.text: Nonmagical light within 20 feet of the swarm goes out. Magical light it touches flickers to dim light.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny moth. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Pale Bites
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Radiant damage, or 4 (1d4 + 2) Radiant damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

CRE-503.cimm: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned

CRE-504.name: Threshold Hound

traits.name: Keeper of the Paths
traits.text: The hound knows every path of the Hollow Verge. It won't let a creature pass the last threshold unless that creature carries an invitation from the deep realm.

traits.name: Shadow Blend
traits.text: In dim light or darkness, the hound can take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and if the target is a creature, it makes a DC 13 Strength save or has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Turning Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature within 60 feet that can hear it. Failure: The target must spend its next turn moving back the way it came.

CRE-504.res: Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing while in dim light or darkness

CRE-505.name: Echo

traits.name: Left Behind
traits.text: The Echo is a copy of someone who passed through the Verge. It knows everything they knew up to that day. If it meets the original, it has Advantage on attack rolls against them.

traits.name: Finish My Life
traits.text: An Echo that is promised its unfinished business will be done for it stops fighting, and fades within a day.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Echo makes two Grey Hand attacks.

actions.name: Grey Hand
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Wear Your Face
actions.text: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. Failure: The Echo becomes a perfect copy of the target until the end of its next turn, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against it.

CRE-505.languages: The languages of the person it copies

traits.name: Gentle
traits.text: A driftwhale fights only if attacked or its young are threatened. Calves (use these statistics as a Huge Beast with 60 Hit Points, CR 2) travel beside it.

traits.name: Silver Sail
traits.text: A driftwhale can carry a driftship's worth of passengers on its back, and salvagers of the Fields follow them to find safe currents.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The driftwhale makes two Tail attacks.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet away.

actions.name: Song (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature of the whale's choice within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, lost in the song. Success: The target is immune to this song for 24 hours.

traits.name: Wreck Lurker
traits.text: The eel has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made among drifting wreckage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The eel makes one Bite and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). Until the grapple ends, the eel can bite only the grappled target.

actions.name: Tail
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 15 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Slip Into the Wreck
bonus.text: The eel moves up to half its Fly Speed through wreckage without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and can take the Hide action.

traits.name: Slaver
traits.text: A Spindleclaw keeps slaves from many worlds: 1d4 thralls (use Thug or Bandit Captain) travel with it.

traits.name: Masters and Hatchlings
traits.text: For a hatchling use CR 1/2, 9 Hit Points and only Bite. For a master use CR 7, 98 Hit Points, and Enslave twice per turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Spindleclaw makes two Bite attacks and uses Enslave if it can.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Enslave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition for 1 day, or until the Spindleclaw dies or is more than 1 mile away. The charmed target obeys its commands. It repeats the save each time it takes damage. Success: Immune for 24 hours.

CRE-509.name: Monument

traits.name: Your Statue
traits.text: The Monument is a statue of one creature in the party, celebrating something they never did. It has Advantage on attack rolls against anyone else, and Disadvantage against them.

traits.name: Stay
traits.text: A creature that reads the plaque on its plinth makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or wants to stay; it won't leave the Monument's island willingly until it finishes a Long Rest elsewhere.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The Monument has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Monument makes two Stone Hand attacks.

actions.name: Stone Hand
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Unveiling (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature within 30 feet that can see it. Failure: The target has the Slowed condition (half Speed, and an action or a Bonus Action, not both) for 1 minute, filled with the memory of a triumph that never happened (it repeats the save at the end of each turn).

CRE-509.cimm: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.text: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

traits.name: False Wreckage
traits.text: The mimic looks like a piece of a lost world: a door, a chest of strange coins, a statue's head. It is indistinguishable from the real thing until it moves.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The mimic makes one Pseudopod and one Bite attack.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is adhered.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

CRE-512.name: Bone Herald

traits.name: Courtesy
traits.text: The herald first delivers its summons, politely. It attacks only those who refuse, and only after they've refused twice.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: While its crowned master stands, a destroyed herald re-forms 1d10 days later beside its master.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The herald makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is pulled up to 10 feet toward the herald.

actions.name: Fetch
actions.text: The herald drags one creature it is grappling up to 30 feet with it, and both are in the Ossuary's court at the start of the herald's next turn if it doesn't take damage before then.

bonus.name: Shadow Step
bonus.text: In dim light or darkness, the herald teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space in dim light or darkness.

CRE-512.languages: Common, and the court speech of a dead kingdom

CRE-513.name: Crowned Dead

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If the Crowned Dead fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Terrified of Ending
traits.text: The Crowned Dead fears a true death above all. A creature that credibly promises it a way to keep existing can bargain with it (Advantage on Charisma checks).

traits.name: Court of the Dead
traits.text: The Crowned Dead holds court with 2d6 courtiers (use Wight) and its Bone Herald.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Crowned Dead makes three Sceptre attacks, or uses Decree and makes one Sceptre attack.

actions.name: Sceptre
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Decree
